issues: 满屏居中的平墙 + 黑底，读作一张截图在滚，没有构图与视觉重心
墙从第一帧起匀速流动，没有起势，节奏平
暗场里的暖白截图卡像漂着的白块，与卡片本身的暖纸色调冲突
整镜没有任何要读的信息，暂停帧不是一张海报
changes: look 改 paper 暖纸：底色与卡片截图同色温，两层暖色软阴影 + 墙远端渐隐进纸色雾出纵深，墙像钉满项目卡的展墙
构图改为墙斜置在右侧 ~65%（rotateY −33° 后退 + rotateX 16° 后仰 + rotateZ 5°）朝右上远去，左侧留给 116px 粗黑体标题「Every project. / Still moving.」（朱红第三行）+ 眉题 + 数据行
节奏：开场墙以 ~4 倍巡航速度冲入，按 τ=11f 指数衰减到巡航（快速段竖向运动模糊），标题随墙减速逐行升起落定
三列差速反向（1.9 / −1.35 / 2.5 px/帧），每列按卡片真实宽高比算单副本周期取模，无缝循环；镜头全程 translateZ 缓推 + 极缓转角
真实截图素材保留（card1–10，列间不复用），文字只作纹理
issuesEn: A full-frame centered flat wall on black read as one screenshot scrolling, with no composition or focal point
The wall flowed at constant speed from frame one, with no build-up and a flat rhythm
The warm-white screenshot cards looked like floating white blocks in the dark, clashing with their own paper tone
Nothing on screen was meant to be read, so no paused frame worked as a poster
changesEn: Switched to the warm paper look: the background matches the cards' color temperature, with two warm soft shadows and the far end of the wall fading into paper-colored haze for depth, like a pinned project wall

The wall now sits angled across the right ~65% of frame (rotateY −33°, rotateX 16° lean, rotateZ 5°) receding to the upper right, leaving the left for a 116px heavy sans headline 'Every project. / Still moving.' (third line in vermilion) with an eyebrow and a stat line
Rhythm: the wall rushes in at ~4x cruise speed and decays exponentially (τ=11f) to cruise, with vertical motion blur during the fast part, while the headline rises line by line as the wall slows

Three columns at different speeds with the middle one reversed (1.9 / −1.35 / 2.5 px/frame); each column wraps on its exact single-copy period computed from the cards' real aspect ratios, so the loop is seamless; the camera pushes in on translateZ and turns very slightly throughout
The real screenshot textures stay (card1–10, never repeated across columns), with their text treated as texture
